Hi Jane / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) What we covered
- Admin activity logs: who performed role changes, user provisioning, permission changes (console + API).
- API request logs: token usage, request/response metadata, latency, and error traces.
- Exportability & retention: CSV/JSON exports via UI and programmatic exports via API; configurable retention windows.
- Immutability / tamper evidence: append-only storage for audit events with hashing and access logs.

2) Open questions you flagged
- SOC 2: whether we can provide our latest report and an expected timeline for an attestation.
- GDPR / data residency: options for log redaction and regional storage.
- Vendor security questionnaire: you'd like to kick off the questionnaire and share an initial set of answers.

3) Proposed next steps
- I will share our audit-logging matrix and SOC 2 summary (attached).
- Aditya (cc'd) will follow up tomorrow with deeper technical details on immutability and export flows.
- Schedule a short session with your security team to walk through the vendor questionnaire — does next week (Tue/Wed) work?

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Audit logging capabilities — technical details and SOC 2 summary

Hi Jane / Tom — following up with the technical details we discussed. Short answers first, then pointers: 

- Tamper evidence / immutability: yes — audit events are stored in an append-only store. Each exported event includes a SHA-256 digest and sequence metadata. We also maintain an access audit trail for who exported or modified retention settings.
  - Customers can export raw events (JSONL) via our admin API endpoint (/v1/admin/logs/export) and each file includes a companion digest file and a manifest.

- Exportability: UI export (CSV/JSON) supports up to 90 days by default; programmatic exports support ad-hoc ranges and pagination. We can provide longer retention on Dedicated/Private deployments.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) covering hosted control plane and logging subsystems in 2025. Attached is the SOC 2 summary and scope document. For customers requiring an examination copy, we support NDA+customer request process.

- GDPR/HIPAA: For GDPR, logs can be redacted on export to remove PII, and residency options exist for Private deployments. For HIPAA customers, we offer BAA for Private and Dedicated contracts — we can share the standard BAA template.

Attachments: soc2-report-2025.pdf (pdf)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-audit-matrix

If helpful, I can prepare a short technical walkthrough (20-30 min) showing an export run and the hash manifest.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
